reason: Reviewed lifecycle hooks, shipped skill and references, harness setup, CLI readiness and domain terms against beta.19 plus the Windows verification deadline and Codex question corrections. Windows repair still requires the exact prepared operation and observed quiet window; the complete administrator-owned Node/npm signature, ACL and hash checks remain, with bounded time for verification and execution. Codex ask offers a linked native form only after the owning app-server transport responds; otherwise native_question_unavailable keeps the ordinary question route. The shipped native-questions reference names this prerequisite. The native runtime now uses its own bounded Unix WebSocket client and a cold-start preflight budget. Answer delivery, acknowledgements, trust, pending session state and beta.19 dormant activation invariants remain unchanged. This corrective release keeps the v1 continuity contract and does not include the separate v2 transition or desktop credential migration.
